title: Display case
description: Display case for armor so it look esthetic
body:
Hi everyone!
I’m Daryl, and I’m officially launching this  mods to the next level. I love creating mod for minecraft, but as my projects get bigger, they require a lot more time and resources to keep them updated and running smoothly .

🛠️ Fixes & Improvements

🖼️ Premium Display Cases
- Cleaner Views: Removed the middle glass divider for a 100% clear view of your items.
- Visual Fixes: Fixed frame Z-fighting (texture flickering).
- Sliding Doors: Doors now slide smoothly instead of swinging.
- Armor UI: Add a UI for the armor slot

🎮 New Controls
Door Interaction
Open/Close: Simply Right-Click any part of the display case (top or bottom half) to swing the door open or shut.
Swing Direction: The door now always swings outwards towards you, rather than inwards.

Armor UI Access
Accessing Slots: Right-Click the display case while the door is OPEN.
The UI: This opens a minimalist 4-slot menu specifically for Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, and Boots.

Old 🎮 Controls

Right-click (empty hand): Open/close door

Shift + Right-click (empty hand): Spawn/remove armor stand

Right-click (with armor, door open): Equip armor on stand

Shift + Right-click (with item): Rotate display

🌟 Why Support?
Your support allows me to dedicate more hours to polishing current features, squashing bugs, and developing brand-new mods that I’ve been dreaming up. By joining the team, you’re fueling the engine that keeps these updates coming!

🛠️ What's Next?
Now that the foundation for the Seamless Display Cases is solid, I’m moving into a big planning phase for the future of my mods. My goal isn't just to add "more stuff"—it’s to create high-quality, polished content that feels like it belongs in the game.

🎯 Overview
Transform your builds with these stunning display cases featuring completely seamless transparent walls and sleek. Perfect for showcasing your most prized items, trophies, collectibles, or creating museum-quality exhibits in your Minecraft world!

💬 I Want Your Feedback!

As I move into this next stage of planning and polishing, I want to hear from you.

Whether it's a small visual glitch, a feature that feels "clunky," or an idea for a better way a block should behave: please leave a comment below. * What can I improve? (Is the UI easy to use? Do the textures look right?)

What needs a fix? (Are there any weird interactions or bugs I missed?)

Your feedback helps me make these mods better for everyone. Don’t be shy—I’m all ears!

✨ Key Features
Seamless Glass Design
Uninterrupted transparency from floor to ceiling - no visible lines or dividers

Glass panels flow continuously between blocks for a premium, professional look

Perfect for viewing your displayed items from any angle

Aesthetic
Sleek and with a modern, appearance

Clean minimalist design that complements any build style

Pillar-style corner supports for structural elegance

5 Stunning Color Variants
Choose the perfect style for your build:

🤍 Clear/White - Classic clean look

⚫ Black - Bold and dramatic

🔵 Blue - Cool cyberpunk vibes

🔴 Red - Eye-catching accent

⚪ White - Pristine and modern

Functional & Interactive
2 blocks tall - Generous display space for any item

Opening doors - Right-click to open/close the front panel

Sliding door mechanism - Smooth animation as doors glide into the frame

Full protection - Keep your valuables secure while showing them off

🎨 Perfect For
Museum Exhibits - Create professional displays for rare items

Trophy Rooms - Showcase your achievements in style

Collectible Galleries - Display armor sets, tools, or special items

Modern Bases - Add futuristic flair to your high-tech builds

Item Shops - Professional product displays for marketplace builds

Server Showcases - Stand out with premium display solutions

🔧 Technical Details
Mod Type: Forge/NeoForge

Minecraft Version: 1.16.5]

Installation: Drop in mods folder and play

Performance: Optimized with minimal performance impact

Compatibility: Works with most other mods

📦 What's Included
5 color variants of display cases

Crafting recipes for all variants

Super Glue item for enhanced functionality

Both upper and lower block components

Open and closed door states

🛠️ Crafting
Each display case can be crafted using glass and your chosen frame material. Recipes are designed to be balanced and accessible in survival mode.

🌟 Why This Mod?
Unlike basic glass blocks or standard display frames, these cases offer:

✅ Zero visual interruption - No ugly middle seams

✅ Connected corners - Professional pillar-style construction

✅ Interactive doors - Functional and visually appealing

✅ Multiple colors - Match any build theme

✅ High-quality design - Built with attention to detail

💬 Community
Your support helps me create more amazing content! Thank you for being a patron and making mods like this possible. Got ideas for new features or color variants? Drop a comment below!

Version History

✨ Completely seamless glass walls with zero middle divider

✨ Connected corner pillars for professional appearance

✨ Functional sliding doors

✨ Optimized rendering for transparent blocks
